599:     private static function splitFormatForSectionSelection(array $sections, mixed $value): array
600:     {
601:         // Extract the relevant section depending on whether number is positive, negative, or zero?
602:         // Text not supported yet.
603:         // Here is how the sections apply to various values in Excel:
604:         //   1 section:   [POSITIVE/NEGATIVE/ZERO/TEXT]
605:         //   2 sections:  [POSITIVE/ZERO/TEXT] [NEGATIVE]
606:         //   3 sections:  [POSITIVE/TEXT] [NEGATIVE] [ZERO]
607:         //   4 sections:  [POSITIVE] [NEGATIVE] [ZERO] [TEXT]
608:         $sectionCount = count($sections);
609:         // Colour could be a named colour, or a numeric index entry in the colour-palette
610:         $color_regex = '/\\[(' . implode('|', Color::NAMED_COLORS) . '|color\\s*(\\d+))\\]/mui';
611:         $cond_regex = '/\\[(>|>=|<|<=|=|<>)([+-]?\\d+([.]\\d+)?)\\]/';
612:         $colors = ['', '', '', '', ''];
613:         $conditionOperations = ['', '', '', '', ''];
614:         $conditionComparisonValues = [0, 0, 0, 0, 0];
615:         for ($idx = 0; $idx < $sectionCount; ++$idx) {
616:             if (preg_match($color_regex, $sections[$idx], $matches)) {
617:                 if (isset($matches[2])) {
618:                     $colors[$idx] = '#' . BIFF8::lookup((int) $matches[2] + 7)['rgb'];
619:                 } else {
620:                     $colors[$idx] = $matches[0];
621:                 }
622:                 $sections[$idx] = (string) preg_replace($color_regex, '', $sections[$idx]);
623:             }
624:             if (preg_match($cond_regex, $sections[$idx], $matches)) {
625:                 $conditionOperations[$idx] = $matches[1];
626:                 $conditionComparisonValues[$idx] = $matches[2];
627:                 $sections[$idx] = (string) preg_replace($cond_regex, '', $sections[$idx]);
628:             }
629:         }
630:         $color = $colors[0];
631:         $format = $sections[0];
632:         $absval = $value;
633:         switch ($sectionCount) {
634:             case 2:
635:                 $absval = abs($value);
636:                 if (!self::splitFormatComparison($value, $conditionOperations[0], $conditionComparisonValues[0], '>=', 0)) {
637:                     $color = $colors[1];
638:                     $format = $sections[1];
639:                 }
640: 
641:                 break;
642:             case 3:
643:             case 4:
644:                 $absval = abs($value);
645:                 if (!self::splitFormatComparison($value, $conditionOperations[0], $conditionComparisonValues[0], '>', 0)) {
646:                     if (self::splitFormatComparison($value, $conditionOperations[1], $conditionComparisonValues[1], '<', 0)) {
647:                         $color = $colors[1];
648:                         $format = $sections[1];
649:                     } else {
650:                         $color = $colors[2];
651:                         $format = $sections[2];
652:                     }
653:                 }
654: 
655:                 break;
656:         }
657: 
658:         return [$color, $format, $absval];
659:     }

682:     protected static function processComplexNumberFormatMask(mixed $number, string $mask): string
683:     {
684:         /** @var string $result */
685:         $result = $number;
686:         $maskingBlockCount = preg_match_all('/0+/', $mask, $maskingBlocks, PREG_OFFSET_CAPTURE);
687: 
688:         if ($maskingBlockCount > 1) {
689:             $maskingBlocks = array_reverse($maskingBlocks[0]);
690: 
691:             $offset = 0;
692:             foreach ($maskingBlocks as $block) {
693:                 $size = strlen($block[0]);
694:                 $divisor = 10 ** $size;
695:                 $offset = $block[1];
696: 
697:                 /** @var float $numberFloat */
698:                 $numberFloat = $number;
699:                 $blockValue = sprintf("%0{$size}d", fmod($numberFloat, $divisor));
700:                 $number = floor($numberFloat / $divisor);
701:                 $mask = substr_replace($mask, $blockValue, $offset, $size);
702:             }
703:             /** @var string $numberString */
704:             $numberString = $number;
705:             if ($number > 0) {
706:                 $mask = substr_replace($mask, $numberString, $offset, 0);
707:             }
708:             $result = $mask;
709:         }
710: 
711:         return self::makeString($result);
712:     }

714:     protected static function complexNumberFormatMask(mixed $number, string $mask, bool $splitOnPoint = true): string
715:     {
716:         /** @var float $numberFloat */
717:         $numberFloat = $number;
718:         if ($splitOnPoint) {
719:             $masks = explode('.', $mask);
720:             if (count($masks) <= 2) {
721:                 $decmask = $masks[1] ?? '';
722:                 $decpos = substr_count($decmask, '0');
723:                 $numberFloat = round($numberFloat, $decpos);
724:             }
725:         }
726:         $sign = ($numberFloat < 0.0) ? '-' : '';
727:         $number = self::f2s(abs($numberFloat));
728: 
729:         if ($splitOnPoint && str_contains($mask, '.') && str_contains($number, '.')) {
730:             $numbers = explode('.', $number);
731:             $masks = explode('.', $mask);
732:             if (count($masks) > 2) {
733:                 $masks = self::mergeComplexNumberFormatMasks($numbers, $masks);
734:             }
735:             $integerPart = self::complexNumberFormatMask($numbers[0], $masks[0], false);
736:             $numlen = strlen($numbers[1]);
737:             $msklen = strlen($masks[1]);
738:             if ($numlen < $msklen) {
739:                 $numbers[1] .= str_repeat('0', $msklen - $numlen);
740:             }
741:             $decimalPart = strrev(self::complexNumberFormatMask(strrev($numbers[1]), strrev($masks[1]), false));
742:             $decimalPart = substr($decimalPart, 0, $msklen);
743: 
744:             return "{$sign}{$integerPart}.{$decimalPart}";
745:         }
746: 
747:         if (strlen($number) < strlen($mask)) {
748:             $number = str_repeat('0', strlen($mask) - strlen($number)) . $number;
749:         }
750:         $result = self::processComplexNumberFormatMask($number, $mask);
751: 
752:         return "{$sign}{$result}";
753:     }

760:     public static function floatStringConvertScientific(string $s): string
761:     {
762:         // convert only normalized form of scientific notation:
763:         //  optional sign, single digit 1-9,
764:         //    decimal point and digits (allowed to be omitted),
765:         //    E (e permitted), optional sign, one or more digits
766:         if (preg_match('/^([+-])?([1-9])([.]([0-9]+))?[eE]([+-]?[0-9]+)$/', $s, $matches) === 1) {
767:             $exponent = (int) $matches[5];
768:             $sign = ($matches[1] === '-') ? '-' : '';
769:             if ($exponent >= 0) {
770:                 $exponentPlus1 = $exponent + 1;
771:                 $out = $matches[2] . $matches[4];
772:                 $len = strlen($out);
773:                 if ($len < $exponentPlus1) {
774:                     $out .= str_repeat('0', $exponentPlus1 - $len);
775:                 }
776:                 $out = substr($out, 0, $exponentPlus1) . ((strlen($out) === $exponentPlus1) ? '' : ('.' . substr($out, $exponentPlus1)));
777:                 $s = "$sign$out";
778:             } else {
779:                 $s = $sign . '0.' . str_repeat('0', -$exponent - 1) . $matches[2] . $matches[4];
780:             }
781:         }
782: 
783:         return $s;
784:     }

786:     protected static function formatStraightNumericValue(mixed $value, string $format, array $matches, bool $useThousands): string
787:     {
788:         /** @var float $valueFloat */
789:         $valueFloat = $value;
790:         $left = $matches[1];
791:         $dec = $matches[2];
792:         $right = $matches[3];
793: 
794:         // minimun width of formatted number (including dot)
795:         $minWidth = strlen($left) + strlen($dec) + strlen($right);
796:         if ($useThousands) {
797:             $value = number_format(
798:                 $valueFloat,
799:                 strlen($right),
800:                 StringHelper::getDecimalSeparator(),
801:                 StringHelper::getThousandsSeparator()
802:             );
803: 
804:             return self::pregReplace(self::NUMBER_REGEX, $value, $format);
805:         }
806: 
807:         if (preg_match('/[0#]E[+-]0/i', $format)) {
808:             //    Scientific format
809:             $decimals = strlen($right);
810:             $size = $decimals + 3;
811: 
812:             return sprintf("%{$size}.{$decimals}E", $valueFloat);
813:         } elseif (preg_match('/0([^\d\.]+)0/', $format) || substr_count($format, '.') > 1) {
814:             if ($valueFloat == floor($valueFloat) && substr_count($format, '.') === 1) {
815:                 $value *= 10 ** strlen(explode('.', $format)[1]);
816:             }
817: 
818:             $result = self::complexNumberFormatMask($value, $format);
819:             if (str_contains($result, 'E')) {
820:                 // This is a hack and doesn't match Excel.
821:                 // It will, at least, be an accurate representation,
822:                 //  even if formatted incorrectly.
823:                 // This is needed for absolute values >=1E18.
824:                 $result = self::f2s($valueFloat);
825:             }
826: 
827:             return $result;
828:         }
829: 
830:         $sprintf_pattern = "%0$minWidth." . strlen($right) . 'F';
831: 
832:         /** @var float $valueFloat */
833:         $valueFloat = $value;
834:         $value = self::adjustSeparators(sprintf($sprintf_pattern, round($valueFloat, strlen($right))));
835: 
836:         return self::pregReplace(self::NUMBER_REGEX, $value, $format);
837:     }

843:         // so this test is never true. Furthermore, testing
844:         // on Excel shows this format uses Euro symbol, not "EUR".
845:         // if ($format === NumberFormat::FORMAT_CURRENCY_EUR_SIMPLE) {
846:         //     return 'EUR ' . sprintf('%1.2f', $value);
847:         // }
848: 
849:         $baseFormat = $format;
850: 
851:         $useThousands = self::areThousandsRequired($format);
852:         $scale = self::scaleThousandsMillions($format);
853: 
854:         if (preg_match('/[#\?0]?.*[#\?0]\/(\?+|\d+|#)/', $format)) {
855:             // It's a dirty hack; but replace # and 0 digit placeholders with ?
856:             $format = (string) preg_replace('/[#0]+\//', '?/', $format);
857:             $format = (string) preg_replace('/\/[#0]+/', '/?', $format);
858:             $value = self::formatFractionMask($value, $format);
859:         } else {
860:             // Handle the number itself
861:             // scale number
862:             $value = $value / $scale;
863:             $paddingPlaceholder = (str_contains($format, '?'));
864: 
865:             // Replace # or ? with 0
866:             $format = self::pregReplace('/[\\#\?](?=(?:[^"]*"[^"]*")*[^"]*\Z)/', '0', $format);
867:             // Remove locale code [$-###] for an LCID
868:             $format = self::pregReplace('/\[\$\-.*\]/', '', $format);
869: 
870:             $n = '/\\[[^\\]]+\\]/';
871:             $m = self::pregReplace($n, '', $format);
872: 
873:             // Some non-number strings are quoted, so we'll get rid of the quotes, likewise any positional * symbols
874:             $format = self::makeString(str_replace(['"', '*'], '', $format));
875:             if (preg_match(self::NUMBER_REGEX, $m, $matches)) {
876:                 // There are placeholders for digits, so inject digits from the value into the mask
877:                 $value = self::formatStraightNumericValue($value, $format, $matches, $useThousands);
878:                 if ($paddingPlaceholder === true) {
879:                     $value = self::padValue($value, $baseFormat);
880:                 }
881:             } elseif ($format !== NumberFormat::FORMAT_GENERAL) {
882:                 // Yes, I know that this is basically just a hack;
883:                 //      if there's no placeholders for digits, just return the format mask "as is"
884:                 $value = self::makeString(str_replace('?', '', $format));
885:             }
886:         }
887: 
888:         if (preg_match('/\[\$(.*)\]/u', $format, $m)) {
889:             //  Currency or Accounting
890:             $currencyCode = $m[1];
891:             [$currencyCode] = explode('-', $currencyCode);
892:             if ($currencyCode == '') {
893:                 $currencyCode = StringHelper::getCurrencyCode();
894:             }
895:             $value = self::pregReplace('/\[\$([^\]]*)\]/u', $currencyCode, (string) $value);
896:         }
897: 
898:         if (
899:             (str_contains((string) $value, '0.'))
900:             && ((str_contains($baseFormat, '#.')) || (str_contains($baseFormat, '?.')))
901:         ) {
902:             $value = preg_replace('/(\b)0\.|([^\d])0\./', '${2}.', (string) $value);

905:         return (string) $value;

    protected static function splitFormatComparison(
        mixed $value,
        ?string $condition,
        mixed $comparisonValue,
        string $defaultCondition,
        mixed $defaultComparisonValue
    ): bool {
        if (!$condition) {
            $condition = $defaultCondition;
            $comparisonValue = $defaultComparisonValue;
        }

        return match ($condition) {
            '>' => $value > $comparisonValue,
            '<' => $value < $comparisonValue,
            '<=' => $value <= $comparisonValue,
            '<>' => $value != $comparisonValue,
            '=' => $value == $comparisonValue,
            default => $value >= $comparisonValue,
        };
    }

    private static function splitFormatForSectionSelection(array $sections, mixed $value): array
    {
        // Extract the relevant section depending on whether number is positive, negative, or zero?
        // Text not supported yet.
        // Here is how the sections apply to various values in Excel:
        //   1 section:   [POSITIVE/NEGATIVE/ZERO/TEXT]
        //   2 sections:  [POSITIVE/ZERO/TEXT] [NEGATIVE]
        //   3 sections:  [POSITIVE/TEXT] [NEGATIVE] [ZERO]
        //   4 sections:  [POSITIVE] [NEGATIVE] [ZERO] [TEXT]
        $sectionCount = count($sections);
        // Colour could be a named colour, or a numeric index entry in the colour-palette
        $color_regex = '/\\[(' . implode('|', Color::NAMED_COLORS) . '|color\\s*(\\d+))\\]/mui';
        $cond_regex = '/\\[(>|>=|<|<=|=|<>)([+-]?\\d+([.]\\d+)?)\\]/';
        $colors = ['', '', '', '', ''];
        $conditionOperations = ['', '', '', '', ''];
        $conditionComparisonValues = [0, 0, 0, 0, 0];
        for ($idx = 0; $idx < $sectionCount; ++$idx) {
            if (preg_match($color_regex, $sections[$idx], $matches)) {
                if (isset($matches[2])) {
                    $colors[$idx] = '#' . BIFF8::lookup((int) $matches[2] + 7)['rgb'];
                } else {
                    $colors[$idx] = $matches[0];
                }
                $sections[$idx] = (string) preg_replace($color_regex, '', $sections[$idx]);
            }
            if (preg_match($cond_regex, $sections[$idx], $matches)) {
                $conditionOperations[$idx] = $matches[1];
                $conditionComparisonValues[$idx] = $matches[2];
                $sections[$idx] = (string) preg_replace($cond_regex, '', $sections[$idx]);
            }
        }
        $color = $colors[0];
        $format = $sections[0];
        $absval = $value;
        switch ($sectionCount) {
            case 2:
                $absval = abs($value);
                if (!self::splitFormatComparison($value, $conditionOperations[0], $conditionComparisonValues[0], '>=', 0)) {
                    $color = $colors[1];
                    $format = $sections[1];
                }

                break;
            case 3:
            case 4:
                $absval = abs($value);
                if (!self::splitFormatComparison($value, $conditionOperations[0], $conditionComparisonValues[0], '>', 0)) {
                    if (self::splitFormatComparison($value, $conditionOperations[1], $conditionComparisonValues[1], '<', 0)) {
                        $color = $colors[1];
                        $format = $sections[1];
                    } else {
                        $color = $colors[2];
                        $format = $sections[2];
                    }
                }

                break;
        }

        return [$color, $format, $absval];
    }

    protected const NUMBER_REGEX = '/(0+)(\\.?)(0*)/';

    protected static function mergeComplexNumberFormatMasks(array $numbers, array $masks): array
    {
        $decimalCount = strlen($numbers[1]);
        $postDecimalMasks = [];

        do {
            $tempMask = array_pop($masks);
            if ($tempMask !== null) {
                $postDecimalMasks[] = $tempMask;
                $decimalCount -= strlen($tempMask);
            }
        } while ($tempMask !== null && $decimalCount > 0);

        return [
            implode('.', $masks),
            implode('.', array_reverse($postDecimalMasks)),
        ];
    }

    protected static function processComplexNumberFormatMask(mixed $number, string $mask): string
    {
        /** @var string $result */
        $result = $number;
        $maskingBlockCount = preg_match_all('/0+/', $mask, $maskingBlocks, PREG_OFFSET_CAPTURE);

        if ($maskingBlockCount > 1) {
            $maskingBlocks = array_reverse($maskingBlocks[0]);

            $offset = 0;
            foreach ($maskingBlocks as $block) {
                $size = strlen($block[0]);
                $divisor = 10 ** $size;
                $offset = $block[1];

                /** @var float $numberFloat */
                $numberFloat = $number;
                $blockValue = sprintf("%0{$size}d", fmod($numberFloat, $divisor));
                $number = floor($numberFloat / $divisor);
                $mask = substr_replace($mask, $blockValue, $offset, $size);
            }
            /** @var string $numberString */
            $numberString = $number;
            if ($number > 0) {
                $mask = substr_replace($mask, $numberString, $offset, 0);
            }
            $result = $mask;
        }

        return self::makeString($result);
    }

    protected static function complexNumberFormatMask(mixed $number, string $mask, bool $splitOnPoint = true): string
    {
        /** @var float $numberFloat */
        $numberFloat = $number;
        if ($splitOnPoint) {
            $masks = explode('.', $mask);
            if (count($masks) <= 2) {
                $decmask = $masks[1] ?? '';
                $decpos = substr_count($decmask, '0');
                $numberFloat = round($numberFloat, $decpos);
            }
        }
        $sign = ($numberFloat < 0.0) ? '-' : '';
        $number = self::f2s(abs($numberFloat));

        if ($splitOnPoint && str_contains($mask, '.') && str_contains($number, '.')) {
            $numbers = explode('.', $number);
            $masks = explode('.', $mask);
            if (count($masks) > 2) {
                $masks = self::mergeComplexNumberFormatMasks($numbers, $masks);
            }
            $integerPart = self::complexNumberFormatMask($numbers[0], $masks[0], false);
            $numlen = strlen($numbers[1]);
            $msklen = strlen($masks[1]);
            if ($numlen < $msklen) {
                $numbers[1] .= str_repeat('0', $msklen - $numlen);
            }
            $decimalPart = strrev(self::complexNumberFormatMask(strrev($numbers[1]), strrev($masks[1]), false));
            $decimalPart = substr($decimalPart, 0, $msklen);

            return "{$sign}{$integerPart}.{$decimalPart}";
        }

        if (strlen($number) < strlen($mask)) {
            $number = str_repeat('0', strlen($mask) - strlen($number)) . $number;
        }
        $result = self::processComplexNumberFormatMask($number, $mask);

        return "{$sign}{$result}";
    }

    public static function f2s(float $f): string
    {
        return self::floatStringConvertScientific((string) $f);
    }

    public static function floatStringConvertScientific(string $s): string
    {
        // convert only normalized form of scientific notation:
        //  optional sign, single digit 1-9,
        //    decimal point and digits (allowed to be omitted),
        //    E (e permitted), optional sign, one or more digits
        if (preg_match('/^([+-])?([1-9])([.]([0-9]+))?[eE]([+-]?[0-9]+)$/', $s, $matches) === 1) {
            $exponent = (int) $matches[5];
            $sign = ($matches[1] === '-') ? '-' : '';
            if ($exponent >= 0) {
                $exponentPlus1 = $exponent + 1;
                $out = $matches[2] . $matches[4];
                $len = strlen($out);
                if ($len < $exponentPlus1) {
                    $out .= str_repeat('0', $exponentPlus1 - $len);
                }
                $out = substr($out, 0, $exponentPlus1) . ((strlen($out) === $exponentPlus1) ? '' : ('.' . substr($out, $exponentPlus1)));
                $s = "$sign$out";
            } else {
                $s = $sign . '0.' . str_repeat('0', -$exponent - 1) . $matches[2] . $matches[4];
            }
        }

        return $s;
    }

    protected static function formatStraightNumericValue(mixed $value, string $format, array $matches, bool $useThousands): string
    {
        /** @var float $valueFloat */
        $valueFloat = $value;
        $left = $matches[1];
        $dec = $matches[2];
        $right = $matches[3];

        // minimun width of formatted number (including dot)
        $minWidth = strlen($left) + strlen($dec) + strlen($right);
        if ($useThousands) {
            $value = number_format(
                $valueFloat,
                strlen($right),
                StringHelper::getDecimalSeparator(),
                StringHelper::getThousandsSeparator()
            );

            return self::pregReplace(self::NUMBER_REGEX, $value, $format);
        }

        if (preg_match('/[0#]E[+-]0/i', $format)) {
            //    Scientific format
            $decimals = strlen($right);
            $size = $decimals + 3;

            return sprintf("%{$size}.{$decimals}E", $valueFloat);
        } elseif (preg_match('/0([^\d\.]+)0/', $format) || substr_count($format, '.') > 1) {
            if ($valueFloat == floor($valueFloat) && substr_count($format, '.') === 1) {
                $value *= 10 ** strlen(explode('.', $format)[1]);
            }

            $result = self::complexNumberFormatMask($value, $format);
            if (str_contains($result, 'E')) {
                // This is a hack and doesn't match Excel.
                // It will, at least, be an accurate representation,
                //  even if formatted incorrectly.
                // This is needed for absolute values >=1E18.
                $result = self::f2s($valueFloat);
            }

            return $result;
        }

        $sprintf_pattern = "%0$minWidth." . strlen($right) . 'F';

        /** @var float $valueFloat */
        $valueFloat = $value;
        $value = self::adjustSeparators(sprintf($sprintf_pattern, round($valueFloat, strlen($right))));

        return self::pregReplace(self::NUMBER_REGEX, $value, $format);
    }

    protected static function formatNumericMask(mixed $value, string $format): string
    {
        self::harvestDisplayHints($value, (string) $format);
        // The "_" in this string has already been stripped out,
        // so this test is never true. Furthermore, testing
        // on Excel shows this format uses Euro symbol, not "EUR".
        // if ($format === NumberFormat::FORMAT_CURRENCY_EUR_SIMPLE) {
        //     return 'EUR ' . sprintf('%1.2f', $value);
        // }

        $baseFormat = $format;

        $useThousands = self::areThousandsRequired($format);
        $scale = self::scaleThousandsMillions($format);

        if (preg_match('/[#\?0]?.*[#\?0]\/(\?+|\d+|#)/', $format)) {
            // It's a dirty hack; but replace # and 0 digit placeholders with ?
            $format = (string) preg_replace('/[#0]+\//', '?/', $format);
            $format = (string) preg_replace('/\/[#0]+/', '/?', $format);
            $value = self::formatFractionMask($value, $format);
        } else {
            // Handle the number itself
            // scale number
            $value = $value / $scale;
            $paddingPlaceholder = (str_contains($format, '?'));

            // Replace # or ? with 0
            $format = self::pregReplace('/[\\#\?](?=(?:[^"]*"[^"]*")*[^"]*\Z)/', '0', $format);
            // Remove locale code [$-###] for an LCID
            $format = self::pregReplace('/\[\$\-.*\]/', '', $format);

            $n = '/\\[[^\\]]+\\]/';
            $m = self::pregReplace($n, '', $format);

            // Some non-number strings are quoted, so we'll get rid of the quotes, likewise any positional * symbols
            $format = self::makeString(str_replace(['"', '*'], '', $format));
            if (preg_match(self::NUMBER_REGEX, $m, $matches)) {
                // There are placeholders for digits, so inject digits from the value into the mask
                $value = self::formatStraightNumericValue($value, $format, $matches, $useThousands);
                if ($paddingPlaceholder === true) {
                    $value = self::padValue($value, $baseFormat);
                }
            } elseif ($format !== NumberFormat::FORMAT_GENERAL) {
                // Yes, I know that this is basically just a hack;
                //      if there's no placeholders for digits, just return the format mask "as is"
                $value = self::makeString(str_replace('?', '', $format));
            }
        }

        if (preg_match('/\[\$(.*)\]/u', $format, $m)) {
            //  Currency or Accounting
            $currencyCode = $m[1];
            [$currencyCode] = explode('-', $currencyCode);
            if ($currencyCode == '') {
                $currencyCode = StringHelper::getCurrencyCode();
            }
            $value = self::pregReplace('/\[\$([^\]]*)\]/u', $currencyCode, (string) $value);
        }

        if (
            (str_contains((string) $value, '0.'))
            && ((str_contains($baseFormat, '#.')) || (str_contains($baseFormat, '?.')))
        ) {
            $value = preg_replace('/(\b)0\.|([^\d])0\./', '${2}.', (string) $value);
        }

        return (string) $value;
    }

    protected static function makeString(array|string $value): string
    {
        return is_array($value) ? '' : "$value";
    }

    protected static function pregReplace(string $pattern, string $replacement, string $subject): string
    {
        return self::makeString(preg_replace($pattern, $replacement, $subject) ?? '');
    }

    public static function padValue(string $value, string $baseFormat): string
    {
        $preDecimal = $postDecimal = '';
        $pregArray = preg_split('/\.(?=(?:[^"]*"[^"]*")*[^"]*\Z)/miu', $baseFormat . '.?');
        if (is_array($pregArray)) {
            $preDecimal = $pregArray[0] ?? '';
            $postDecimal = $pregArray[1] ?? '';
        }

        $length = strlen($value);
        if (str_contains($postDecimal, '?')) {
            $value = str_pad(rtrim($value, '0. '), $length, ' ', STR_PAD_RIGHT);
        }
        if (str_contains($preDecimal, '?')) {
            $value = str_pad(ltrim($value, '0, '), $length, ' ', STR_PAD_LEFT);
        }

        return $value;
    }

    /**
     * Find out if we need thousands separator
     * This is indicated by a comma enclosed by a digit placeholders: #, 0 or ?
     */
    public static function areThousandsRequired(string &$format): bool
    {
        $useThousands = (bool) preg_match('/([#\?0]),([#\?0])/', $format);
        if ($useThousands) {
            $format = self::pregReplace('/([#\?0]),([#\?0])/', '${1}${2}', $format);
        }

        return $useThousands;
    }

    /**
     * Scale thousands, millions,...
     * This is indicated by a number of commas after a digit placeholder: #, or 0.0,, or ?,.
     */
    public static function scaleThousandsMillions(string &$format): int
    {
        $scale = 1; // same as no scale
        if (preg_match('/(#|0|\?)(,+)/', $format, $matches)) {
            $scale = 1000 ** strlen($matches[2]);
            // strip the commas
            $format = self::pregReplace('/([#\?0]),+/', '${1}', $format);
        }

        return $scale;
    }
